title: Julius forms his own band; Teddy Riley and the advice not to imitate
summary: He hires Kid Clayton, Billy, Dee Dee and Booker T, encourages Teddy Riley, and repeats his father's advice never to copy others.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
